full_prompt_en: A square analog-style collage assembles a large right-facing woman's profile from overlapping black-and-white photographs and small colored paper fragments on a warm cream ground. The face dominates the center and lower right, with a dark swept fringe, one visible blue-tinted eye, a long nose, and parted lips. Several abrupt rectangular seams cross the hair, cheek, and chin, making the portrait feel constructed from different prints rather than captured as one photograph. On the left, a much smaller dark figure seen from behind stands before a pale mountain landscape, partly swallowed by the larger face and layers of gray imagery. A short strip of parallel black lines sits near the upper-left corner. In the upper-right, a tiny photograph of a hand holding a camera interrupts another mountainous scene. Below it, a narrow torn band of rusty red, ochre, and muted teal cuts across a dark blue image field. More black-and-white landscape fragments and small photographic textures cluster along the bottom edge and behind the chin. The cream paper remains visible around the outer edges, keeping the crowded center from filling the entire square. Some boundaries are straight as cut print, while others are jagged, torn, or partially transparent; differing grain and contrast reveal the separate sources. Light is inherited from the photographs, with pale highlights on the eye, nose, and lips and deeper gray shadow across the lower face. The flat assembled surface has no unified cast shadow, but overlap creates shallow physical depth. The overall composition is introspective and fragmented, balancing one large human silhouette with small distant views and restrained orange-blue color interruptions.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形的模拟手工拼贴画在暖奶油色底上，用互相叠压的黑白照片和少量彩纸碎片拼成一位朝右女子的大幅侧脸。面部主导中央与右下方，有深色向一侧扫过的刘海、一只带蓝调的眼睛、修长鼻子和微张的嘴唇。数道突兀的矩形拼接线穿过发丝、脸颊和下颏，使肖像显得由不同印刷片组成，而非一次拍摄的照片。左边，一个从背后看去的小小深色人物站在浅色山景前，部分被大脸和灰色图层吞没。左上角附近放着一小段平行黑线。右上方，一张手持相机的小照片打断了另一片山景。其下，一条锈红、赭黄和柔和青绿的狭窄撕裂纸带，横过深蓝色图像区域。更多黑白风景碎片与细小照片肌理聚在底边和下巴后面。奶油色纸面仍沿外缘露出，使拥挤中央没有占满整幅方画。有的边缘像裁切印刷品般笔直，有的锯齿状、撕裂或部分透明；不同颗粒与反差显示出素材来源各异。光线沿袭各张照片，眼、鼻、唇上有浅色高光，下方面部有较深灰影。平面拼合表面没有统一投影，但重叠制造浅浅的物理纵深。整体构图内省而破碎，以一张巨大人像剪影平衡小小的远方景象及克制的橙蓝色插入。
style_prompt_en: An analog cut-paper collage combines high-contrast grayscale photography with a few restrained blocks of rusty orange, muted teal, and dark blue. Straight print boundaries alternate with torn irregular seams; visible paper grain and mismatched photographic textures make the layering explicit. One dominant central shape is interrupted by much smaller inset rectangles and partial overlays, producing a rhythm of near and far scales. Lighting remains native to each fragment, so bright photographic highlights and deep charcoal patches coexist without a single cast-shadow scheme. Cream negative space around the edges gives the crowded middle room to breathe. The overall effect is fragmented, tactile, and introspective, with shallow overlap replacing conventional perspective.
style_prompt_zh: 模拟剪纸拼贴将高反差灰阶照片与少量锈橙、柔和青绿和深蓝色块结合。笔直的印刷边界与撕裂不规则接缝交替；可见纸纹和不一致的照片肌理明确显示层叠关系。一个占主导的中央形体被更小的嵌入矩形和局部覆层切开，产生远近尺度节奏。光线保留在各自碎片中，因此明亮照片高光与深炭色斑块并存，不服从单一投影规律。边缘的奶油色留白为拥挤中央留出呼吸空间。整体效果破碎、可触而内省，以浅层重叠取代常规透视。
theme_en: A black-and-white profile assembled from photographs and colored paper fragments
theme_zh: 由黑白照片和彩纸碎片拼成的侧脸
name: Collage
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
